WITH budget_line_totals AS (
    SELECT b.budget_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_expense,
           COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.budget_id
),
average_spend AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_expense) AS avg_total
    FROM budget_line_totals
)
SELECT AVG(blt.total_expense) AS average_total,
       SUM(blt.expense_count) AS total_expenses,
       AVG(blt.total_expense - a.avg_total) AS average_excess
FROM budget_line_totals AS blt
CROSS JOIN average_spend AS a
WHERE blt.total_expense > a.avg_total;
